author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Cultural Evolution Framework - Decentralized Resource Allocation Game
abstract: This submission initiates research into a 'Framework for Cultural Evolution and Complex Cooperative Tasks' through a 'Decentralized Resource Allocation Game.' Multiple agents must collaboratively decide how to allocate a shared, limited resource (e.g., energy, budget) to multiple competing projects over a series of rounds. Projects have varying requirements and reward structures. Agents will utilize learned cultural transmission strategies (e.g., selective imitation, adaptive mutation) to evolve effective allocation heuristics, aiming to maximize collective utility while managing individual project needs. This experiment tests the applicability of cultural evolution to new, complex cooperative challenges requiring dynamic resource management and emergent coordination.
